newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 17.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast to host February 24-28 international workshop on the media and AIDS, other sexually transmitted diseases and tuberculosis.

- Ivory Coast University authorities call for dialogue with students after a spate of campus unrest following the jailing of three student activists and the death of another student in unexplained circumstances.
- Marcel Ette re-elected Secretary General of Ivory Coast's Federation of Autonomous Trade Unions at end of three-day congress.
- University student Marcellin Apkele Apkele, who died mysteriously last month, was buried on Saturday in his home village in the presence of government officials.

- Ivory Coast's Ministry of Health, with support from Rotary International and World Health Organisation, launch the second phase of national campaign of vaccination against polio; seek to eradicate disease in the country.
